title: Hacking Hours: Neuromorphic Software Development Sessions
summary: Open Neuromorphic hosts live 'Hacking Hour' sessions led by Jens Pedersen focusing on neuromorphic software development. Topics include coding practices for ReRAM non-volatile memory IP, utilizing open-source Caravel and OpenLane platforms to tape out energy-efficient edge SoCs, extracting computational graphs with torch.fx for the Neuromorphic Intermediate Representation (NIR), optimizing recurrent SNN loops using JAX's scan operation, deploying models via Faery's stream-based API on Innatera mixed-signal chips, and automating Rust-backed compilation with GitHub Actions. No sessions are currently scheduled as of 2025-10-19.
tldr: Open Neuromorphic offers live hacking hour sessions covering neuromorphic software tools like NIR, Faery, Caravel, and ReRAM IP integration for edge SoC development.
evidence: Join Jens Pedersen and guests for live Hacking Hour sessions, diving into neuromorphic software, coding practices, and collaborative problem-solving.
Discover how combining ReRAM non-volatile memory IP with open-source Caravel and OpenLane platforms enables students to tape out energy-efficient edge SoCs.
Learn how extracting computational graphs with torch.fx allows the Neuromorphic Intermediate Representation (NIR) to bridge PyTorch models and SNN hardware.
